heading: side
name: 側邊標題欄＋標題列列表
desc: 左緣貼齊畫面、右側圓角的卡片區塊；左側窄欄放標題組、一組直向文字連結和底部的文字連結加圓形按鈕，右側是以分隔線隔開的項目列表，每列只有小標籤與標題，每列右端一顆圓形圖示按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左側貼齊畫面左緣，右側與上下留邊；右側兩個角（右上、右下）做圓角，左側兩個角（左上、左下）為直角。標題組放在左側一欄，約佔內容寬度的三成，其餘約七成是多個項目排成的直列，左欄標題的頂端和第一列的頂端對齊；標題組包含標題，下方可放小字，沒有時省略，標題明顯大於列表的文字。標題組下方隔一段空白可放一組直向排列的小型文字連結，目前選取的一項顏色較深、前方有小圓點，其他較淡；左欄底部可放一個文字連結加一顆圓形圖示按鈕，大約對齊最後一列，沒有時省略。每一列無外框，上下兩層：上層是次要文字加一個膠囊狀小標籤，下層只有標題，沒有其他說明文字；每列右端放一顆圓形圖示按鈕，垂直置中。每一列下方都有一條分隔線，橫跨整個列表欄的寬度。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，由上而下：標題組靠左，原本直向排列的小型文字連結改成標題組下方的一排橫向文字連結，接著是列表，最後是文字連結加圓形圖示按鈕，移到區塊最下方靠左。列表每列右端的圓形圖示按鈕不顯示，其他組成與分隔線不變，標題文字變長時自動換行。卡片仍是左側貼齊畫面左緣、右側留邊，右上、右下做圓角。只靠滑鼠的效果在觸控裝置上取消。

en.name: Side heading column + title row list
en.desc: A card section flush with the left edge of the screen with rounded right corners; a narrow left column holds the heading group, a vertical set of text links and a text link with a circular button at the bottom, and the right side is a list of rows separated by dividers, each holding only a label and a title, each ending in a circular icon button.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card, flush with the left edge of the screen, with margins on the right, top and bottom; the two right corners (top-right, bottom-right) are rounded corners, and the two left corners (top-left, bottom-left) are square corners. Place the heading group in a side column on the left, taking about thirty percent of the content width, with the rest of the content, about seventy percent, in the other column as a list of rows of multiple items; the top of the title in the left column aligns with the top of the first row. The heading group contains a title, optionally with small text below it; omit it when there is no content. The title is noticeably larger than the text in the list. Below the heading group, after some space, optionally place a vertical set of small text links, where the currently selected link is darker with a small dot in front of it and the others are lighter; optionally place a text link with a circular icon button at the bottom of the left column, roughly aligned with the last row; omit them when there is no content. Each row has no border and has two tiers: the upper tier is secondary text followed by a small pill-shaped label, and the lower tier holds only the title, with no other description; each row ends with a circular icon button on the right, vertically centered. Every row has a divider below it, spanning the full width of the list column.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout stacks vertically, from top to bottom: the heading group aligned left, then the small text links, which change from a vertical set into a single horizontal row below the heading group, then the list, and finally the text link with the circular icon button, moved to the bottom of the section, aligned left. The circular icon button at the right end of each row is hidden; the rest of each row and the dividers stay the same, and long titles wrap automatically. The card stays flush with the left edge of the screen with a margin on the right, and the top-right and bottom-right corners rounded. Mouse-only effects are removed on touch devices.

extras.name: 滑過列的分隔線與按鈕效果
extras.prompt: 滑鼠移到列表的某一列上時，這一列下方的分隔線從左往右畫出一條較深的線，右端的圓形圖示按鈕變成深色，這一列的標題稍微往右移；滑鼠離開後恢復原狀。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果。

en.name: Row hover divider and button effect
en.prompt: When the mouse moves over a row of the list, a darker line is drawn from left to right along the divider below that row, the circular icon button at the right end turns dark, and the row's title shifts slightly to the right; everything returns to normal when the mouse leaves.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: The effect is removed on touch devices.
